newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low vs dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down against the dollar as banks preferred to hold on to the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.86 to the dollar after opening at 58.80. On Thursday, the rupee closed at 58.70.
"Most banks preferred to hold on to dollars. They can see the Central Bank pushing up the dollar down the line," a Hatton National Bank dealer said.
Despite the dollar's overseas weakening on Friday, the Central Bank kept its buying and selling rates unchanged at 57.8556 and 59.0244.
Overnight call money closed at nine percent with the market well offered, after opening at 15 percent, dealers said.
"The two state banks were lending large amounts, which kept the money market liquid," said a foreign bank dealer.
Dealing resumes on the Colombo forex market on Wednesday after the Sinhala and Tamil New Year celebrations.
